يستجلوا (form X)
# يَسْتَجْلُوا (yastajlū) /jas.tad͡ʒ.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
# يُسْتَجْلَوْا (yustajlaw) /jus.tad͡ʒ.law/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
